_comment: 9532 Servals tugging a fish (two) with a third serval watching, flat overcast (R5 II CR3, 8192x5464). Archived 2026-11-18 BEFORE the user saved the TIFF (path not known yet; the document had no path) and before a final read of the live filter: the filter below is the last state written by Claude and verified by readback (6 corrections, no Remove, no Lens Blur); the crop is the last one set by script (16:10, 7784x4865). A pending Crop-tool box in Photoshop had twice committed a 16:9 crop over a scripted crop — if the saved TIFF is not 7784x4865, trust the TIFF. Raw SO (not readable, entered by hand): AI Denoise (user) only; no WB/Calibration change. Filter = one Camera Raw Filter on layer id 2. $BigT (Select Subject bitmap, ~270 KB) is omitted — cannot be replayed: re-run Select Subject (covers all three animals and the fish), then clone the Subject component into the other corrections (new MaskSyncID, digests from the live read). Mask coords normalized to the UNCROPPED 8192x5464 layer. Local Exposure: dialog = 4 x stored. Lens Blur deliberately NOT used (user decision: it would not work on this frame). The two Eye corrections (radials on each eye) were removed: eyes are dark slits in profile, a brightening could not be seen.

raw_so_manual.Temperature/Tint: unchanged (neutrals warm by ~+3..4 b* but sand/dry grass bounce explains it; reads natural)
